issues.claim: Coverage of the zone's business groups
issues.problem: The list is dominated by professional/medical/personal-care categories and omits whole eligible categories that the mapper's own sources (the NJTGO Bound Brook and South Bound Brook business pages, both re-opened) list in-town: home and building trades (plumbing, electrical, roofing, HVAC, fireproofing, glass, painting, garage doors, carpet cleaning), auto repair and body shops, laundromats/dry cleaning, printing, computer repair, pet grooming and several tax offices. I found only about 6 of the 48 eligible in-zone independents I identified already listed (~12%), far below the 70% bar.
issues.fix: Expand the list to cover the trade/auto/everyday-service categories, e.g. Jeffrey Burke Plumbing (418 Talmadge Ave), JDP Electric (305 E High St Ste 4), Mineo Electric (120 E Union Ave), DeWitt Van Nest Electrical (365 Talmage Ave), Fisher Automotive (506 E Main St), Nerger's Auto Express (101 W Main St), W&W Truck Center (432 Talmage Ave), Carter & Sons Roofing (87 Main St, SBB), Colonial Door Co (169 Canal Rd, SBB), Dunn's Printing (28 Main St, SBB), Safe Haven Computers (34 Main St, SBB), Aeromundo LLC (9 W Main St), Kissel Agency (643 Central Ave).

issues.claim: Zone label 'Bound Brook and South Bound Brook | groups ABCD'
issues.problem: Every entry in businesses.json carries group 'A' or 'B'; there are no group C or D entries, and sources_used/categories_thin/caveats/data_gaps are all empty arrays despite thin single-source entries. The file does not deliver what its zone label claims.
issues.fix: Either populate groups C and D, or relabel the zone to 'groups AB' and fill in categories_thin / caveats / data_gaps so downstream triage knows what was not covered.

issues.claim: Bound Brook Smiles, 123 E Maple Ave, Bound Brook
issues.problem: The cited contact page (boundbrooksmiles.com/contact-us) shows the practice and its hours but the address and phone fields render empty on the page, and the homepage I opened contains no street number; the 123 E Maple Ave address rests on the BBB profile alone, which I did not open.
issues.fix: Open the BBB profile or another source to confirm 123 E Maple Ave before outreach; mark the address as single-source if BBB is the only support.

issues.claim: Toro Taxes Bound Brook, 303 E 2nd St
issues.problem: Address and phone are confirmed on its own site, but Toro Taxes is a branded tax-prep network whose national site (torotaxes.com/locations) lists this office as a location. Inference (not stated in a source): this looks like a franchise/branded outlet, which the mapper's exclusion rule for chains and franchises would rule out.
issues.fix: Confirm whether this office is an independent franchisee; if the exclusion applies, remove it and note the decision.

issues.claim: Sandoval Express Services, LLC note ('the earlier Sandoval Express Insurance name was wrong')
issues.problem: The note mischaracterises the cited source: the NJTGO Bound Brook page I opened lists this business as 'Sandoval Express Insurance' at 409-B East Main St, while Progressive lists 'Sandoval Express Services, LLC' at the same address. Both names are in the cited sources, so calling one 'wrong' without saying which source it came from is misleading.
issues.fix: Reword the note as 'NJTGO uses Sandoval Express Insurance; Progressive uses Sandoval Express Services, LLC' and keep one entry.

issues.claim: Robert D. Spengler, Attorney at Law, 59 W Union Ave
issues.problem: Address confirmed on the borough municipal directory, but the only role the borough lists is Municipal Public Defender / Assistant Prosecutor, i.e. a publicly appointed position. Government is an excluded type; the private practice is asserted in the notes but not evidenced by any source in the file.
issues.fix: Add a source for the private practice (or a second, non-government listing) or flag the entry as government-adjacent and deprioritise it.

issues.claim: Jeffrey Kaladas, MD, 141 Main St, Suite 1, South Bound Brook
issues.problem: The only source is an RWJBarnabas MyChart provider page, which I could not open (JavaScript-gated system portal). The entry itself calls the practice part of a large health system, which is borderline for the independent-business rule.
issues.fix: Re-source to an open directory page or drop; if kept, mark as health-system-employed rather than independent.

issues.claim: Group A entries sourced only to the 08805 tax-preparation directory (Auletta, Licari, David R. Morris, Bottom Line Bookkeeping, Vecchio, Miriam's Services)
issues.problem: All were confirmed at the listed address on that page, but the page is a thin aggregator and several of the addresses (595 Watchung Rd, 266 Nagle St) look residential. Inference: these are likely home-based practices, which risks publishing personal/residential addresses.
issues.fix: Corroborate with a second source or omit the street number for apparently home-based practitioners; note the single-source risk in caveats.

issues.claim: Yellow Pages, Super Lawyers and FindLaw citations (Dicellis & Faccone, Herbert M. Benton, Petraske Castillo and Notarangelo, Law Office of John E. Bruder, and the South Bound Brook CPA page)
issues.problem: Those URLs return HTTP 403 to automated fetches, so they cannot be independently re-opened. I could only re-confirm Dicellis & Faccone and Herbert M. Benton through other pages/search results; the two law firms could not be verified at all.
issues.fix: Replace 403-blocked citations with an open source (e.g. the njnewjerseytax.com 08805 page for the CPAs) or mark the two law firms as unverified single-source entries.
